head_commit.message:
feat: phase 12 store readiness - real account deletion, settings hub & legal surfaces

API: DELETE /auth/me deactivates the credential, anonymizes identity
fields, soft-deletes the athlete profile, revokes all sessions and
writes a PII-free audit trail, with full integration test coverage
(anonymous rejection, scrubbing verification, post-deletion login block).

Mobile: account deletion flow with explicit acknowledgment wired to the
real endpoint via AuthNotifier.deleteAccount; Settings hub exposing all
spec sections (profile, security/sessions, notifications, payments,
tickets, blocked users, support tickets, terms, privacy policy,
deletion, logout); Terms of Service and Privacy Policy screens that
describe actual implemented behavior; profile card now routes into the
hub instead of a flat inline list.

head_commit.message:
feat(mobile): wire remaining static-mock screens to real providers and complete retry coverage

C1: trailing Retry buttons on error states across tournament operations,
referee, athlete and settings screens.

C2: nominations, blocked users, tickets, championships + belt lineage,
venues, account-security sessions, informal events (browse/join/leave/
cancel/create) and training log (PRs + session history from GYM posts)
all read live API data via existing Riverpod providers. Fake success
snackbars and invented backends removed.
